summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A., an Argentine real estate and agricultural company, furnished a Form 6-K containing an English translation of a letter filed with Argentina's CNV and BYMA. The letter reports audited fiscal year 2026 results, including net income of ARS 372,280 million, equity breakdown, share capital details, and ownership structure. Eduardo Elsztain beneficially owns 39.22% of shares. The board is beginning to analyze proposals for the next annual shareholders meeting, but no specific transaction or event is announced. This is a routine periodic results report, not a special situation. Watch for future proposals from the board regarding capital allocation or dividends.
